variant_desc: memcpy(src->tmp); transform(tmp,tmp); memcpy(tmp->dst) -> transform(src,dst) directly (variant 2: seed=44, n_scale=1.5x)
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition of redundant defensive copies around a noinline cross-TU transform. Compilers cannot eliminate the memcpy()s because the transform's body is opaque (separate TU + noinline) -- the compiler must assume the transform might alias the input/output through some side channel, so the safe-but-wasteful copies must stay.
